trusted_sections: Work Package PX0-05 - Existing Capability Migration
Task 11: Migrate Dashboard, Control, Inspect, Runtime, and Performance panels
Task 12: Add Scenarios workspace without semantic bypass

trusted_statements.objective: Replace the PX0-04 transitional legacy contribution with explicit built-in panel contributions that place all already-authorized Debug UI capabilities into the approved Dashboard, Control, Inspect, Runtime, Performance and Scenarios workspaces, without inventing new product semantics or bypassing Runtime/debug-control ownership.
trusted_statements.panel_contract: Every built-in panel consumes only DebugPanelContext{const DebugSnapshot&, DebugControlRouter&, DebugUiSessionState&}. No built-in panel may fetch RuntimeFacade, diagnostics providers, platform hosts, Skia surfaces, SemanticDocument, RuntimeScene or owner pointers directly.

dashboard_mapping.CurrentProductState: resolved toolId, brushId/revision, eraserId, selection mode/count, camera scale/translation, undo/redo state
dashboard_mapping.RecentActivity: bounded recent Debug Control Plane entries from snapshot.activity

Ink: size/opacity/other brush parameter rows shown Unsupported because PX0 does not authorize a new parameter mutation contract
View: Zoom At explicit anchor and scale delta
control_mapping.Feature: reserved successor feature slot shown Unsupported/Not implemented; no Shape/RichText/Connector/Snap/Image semantics

control_readback_rules: Brush selected state comes from snapshot.product.value.tool.brushId and brushRevision, never a static/local selected preset.
Eraser selected state comes from snapshot.product.value.tool.eraserId.
Selection selected state comes from snapshot.product.value.selection.enabled.
Camera display comes from snapshot.product.value.camera plus Axiom camera generation when available.
Surface selected/resolved state comes from snapshot.platform.value.canonicalSurfaceMode and generations, never a local requested-mode variable.
Legacy numeric toolId remains display-only diagnostic data. PX0-05 must not interpret toolId==4107 as semantic Pan or Selection truth.
Persistent mode controls must reflect the next owner/runtime snapshot after a submission.
view_rules: Pan uses RuntimeFacade through DebugControlRouter::panBy and explicit UI-local delta inputs.
Zoom At uses DebugControlRouter::zoomAt and explicit UI-local anchorX/anchorY/scaleDelta inputs because the current common snapshot does not expose a canonical viewport-center anchor.
Fit Selection is disabled when selectedObjectCount == 0 and never falls back to Fit Content.
Fit Primary Object is disabled when primaryObject == 0.
Reset View and 100% zoom controls do not exist in PX0-05.
Camera draft values are DebugUiSessionState only and are not Runtime truth.

inspect_mapping.Object: Unsupported placeholder because no bounded object-detail projection exists in the current DebugSnapshot
inspect_mapping.Interaction: ARC active pointers/input batches plus Axiom overlay/transient interaction counters
inspect_mapping.Relationship: Unsupported placeholder because no relationship projection exists

runtime_mapping.Document: document generation/revision and canonical operation count
runtime_mapping.Scene: Unsupported placeholder when the current DebugSnapshot has no bounded scene diagnostic payload
runtime_mapping.ARC: preview revision, active pointers, input batches, handoffs, preview active
runtime_mapping.Render: available bounded render/frame counters already present in Platform/Telemetry
runtime_mapping.Surface: resolved canonical mode, canonical/preview generations, dimensions, DPR, availability, present/lost counters, latest Surface receipt, and PlatformDefault/CPU/GPU requests through DebugControlRouter
runtime_mapping.FeatureDiagnostics: Unsupported placeholder until typed feature diagnostics are actually projected into DebugSnapshot
runtime_mapping.AdvancedActions: Force Full Redraw is the only currently actionable advanced Runtime command in PX0-05 when an AxiomDebug owner is bound; Set Overlay Flags, Force Scene Recompile, Evict Tile Cache, Evict Raster Cache, Pause Background Raster and Runtime Memory Budget remain visible Unsupported because current support/readback/unit semantics are absent

performance_mapping.LiveMetrics: telemetry sequence/sampleHz/frameMs/queueAgeMs plus Reset Rolling Metrics when an AxiomDebug owner is bound
performance_mapping.InputARC: telemetry inputEvents plus ARC active pointers/input batches/handoffs

engineering_owner_presence.rule: Panels may not receive raw owners. DebugControlRouter may expose read-only owner-presence queries for Runtime/AxiomDebug/PlatformDebug so controls can render Unsupported rather than appearing enabled when no owner is bound.
engineering_owner_presence.scope: Owner-presence queries expose pointer binding only; they do not become a dynamic feature-capability registry or command support matrix.

scenario_mapping.rule: No scenario button may mutate RuntimeFacade, DebugControlRouter, SemanticDocument, RuntimeScene, selection, renderer state or evidence storage in PX0-05.

transitional_cleanup: Remove the PX0-04 Transitional legacy controls contribution and its internal legacy tab bar/body from controller.cpp.
buildImGuiPanels remains as the PX0-04 compatibility entrypoint for current Windows/Web hosts until PX0-06, but it renders only the final PX0-05 built-in registry content.
DebugController remains common orchestration; Workbench/PanelRegistry architecture is not redesigned.
preserved_boundaries: PX0-02 structured immutable DebugSnapshot and assembler
Windows/Web production host composition remains unchanged until PX0-06

forbidden_interpretations: PX0-05 does not add brush size, opacity, color or other parameter mutation merely because CanvasControl has internal option types.
PX0-05 does not reinterpret legacy toolId values as a new stable semantic tool taxonomy.
PX0-05 does not add Reset View or 100% zoom semantics.
PX0-05 does not introduce Shape, RichText editing, Connector, Snap or Image product behavior.
PX0-05 does not add Trace/GPU profiler toggles, memory-budget units/ranges, overlay flag names, scene/cache semantics or background-raster readback absent from Authority.
PX0-05 does not activate Reset Canvas/Empty Canvas/Ink Baseline through direct Document/Scene mutation.
PX0-05 does not thin Windows/Web hosts or move their composition root to DebugController; that is PX0-06.
PX0-05 does not modify Runtime semantic contracts, stable Runtime C ABI, Preview, DUI-M1 evidence status, or G5.
